title: App shell looks, round 1
lede: Six look calls from the 10-30 nq alignment pass, NOW on origin/main beside NEW with the change injected, at 390px. Yes opens a follow-up code PR, No keeps today's look.

items.label: Menu font
items.change: Shell loads Mulish itself instead of falling back to the system font

items.meta: rec Yes: one address face on every device

items.label: Menu colours on a tokened host

items.meta: rec Yes: 0 px change on hosts whose tokens match
